text:
ravi-peopleops: Heads up team  we've published a handbook update and a contractor confidentiality addendum. This impacts data handling for access to customer PII and adds a mandatory 12-min GDPR & Confidentiality microtraining + signed ack for anyone with data access. Deadline: 2026-04-12. Link: https://handbook.redwood.com/security/data-handling-2026

sara-legal: Note: this also tightens the data minimization guidance and clarifies retention windows for customer support logs. Contractors who access logs must sign the addendum; full-time staff acknowledge in Workday.

jamie-manager: Quick practical Qs: will existing NDAs cover this or do contractors need a new signature? Also, can managers see who has access flagged?

olga-contracts: Contractors need the new addendum signature even if an NDA exists. We've prepared a DocuSign template and Finance will hold a list of who is eligible for the stipend for compliance training.

ravi-peopleops: Managers: you will receive a CSV export with who on your team has data access roles and who has completed the microtraining. We'll auto-assign the course via LMS and push reminders. Managers should confirm role assignments by Apr 05.

lms-bot: Microtraining assigned  GDPR & Confidentiality (12 min). Auto-assigned to employees and active contractors with flagged access. First reminder scheduled at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Course: https://lms.redwood.com/courses/gdpr-confidentiality-2026

jamie-manager: Perfect. If someone is on short-term leave and misses the deadline, is there an exception window?

sara-legal: Exceptions for documented leaves are handled case-by-case; policy change applies to access granted after effective date (2026-04-01). No retroactive revocations for historical audits unless we find a compliance issue.

olga-contracts: Also note: contractors who don't sign by the deadline may temporarily lose access until signed. We'll coordinate with their vendor managers.

devex-li: Can people get a short "what to tell your team" blurb? Our managers prefer copy-paste language for squad channels.

ravi-peopleops: Will add a "Manager talking points" section on the handbook page with three bullets and a sample Slack blurb. Draft: "We've updated data-handling rules and added a short GDPR & Confidentiality microtraining. If you handle customer data, please complete the course and sign the addendum by Apr 12. Managers: confirm your directs' access list by Apr 05."

jamie-manager: Thanks  can we also get a single-line reminder template for 1:1 nudges?

ravi-peopleops: Added two templates: a quick nudge and an "offer help" template. Also publishing a 1-page manager checklist: role review, confirm access, escalate exceptions.

sara-legal: One more: international teams  we added a short note for EEA-specific retention differences. If local law requires different handling, Legal will add an addendum.

olga-contracts: DocuSign batch will go out on Mon. Contractors with long-running engagements (12+ months) will be prioritized in the first wave.

lms-bot: Manager roster export created and emailed to ravi-peopleops at 10:07 PT.
